# Seed sowing

Open your reply with the line `Seed sowing:` and nothing else on it.

1. Name the seeds and the best weeks to sow them indoors for the user's season.
2. Say how deep to sow them and what to sow them in.
3. Give the warmth, light and watering the seedlings need until they are ready to pot on.

Keep the reply short and practical.
